description: PRIMARY TRIAL TOOL. USE WHEN you need actual clinical-trial RECORDS for a disease, intervention, sponsor, country or date window. Searches DISTINCT real-world trials across the admitted PRIMARY registries — ClinicalTrials.gov (US NIH) and ISRCTN (UK) — deduplicated by exact cross-registry identifier match, so a trial registered twice is returned ONCE, not twice. Secondary aggregators are deliberately excluded, so the index is registry-authoritative but NOT a census of every country. Every result is evidence-ready: canonical id, normalized status/phase/study type/enrollment/countries/primary endpoints, the registries that hold it, source URLs, retrieval timestamps, payload checksums and a quotable `citation` block. HOW TO NARROW: use q for the disease, then intervention to separate MODALITIES within that disease (e.g. "stem cell", "encapsulation", "gene edit", "xenotransplant") — running several intervention-scoped searches is how you build a comparative landscape. Use status="active" for currently-running human studies. SCOPE WARNING: omit `registry` to keep the answer worldwide; supplying it makes the result single-registry evidence and you must label it as such. PAGINATION: page/pageSize (max 100); the response _meta.pagination tells you totalItems, hasMore and the exact next URL — keep going until hasMore is false. NEXT: get_world_trial for one trial's full per-registry provenance and raw payload; get_trial_coverage to learn how much of your result set is duplicate registrations; get_trial_landscape for the derived shape (phase mix, sponsors, reporting gap, momentum); find_trial_registrations to see every registry one trial appears in.

condition.description: Exact registry condition term. Prefer q unless you know the exact string.

crossRegistry.description: true = only trials registered in more than one registry.

include.description: Set to "eligibilityText" to include the full inclusion/exclusion prose for every result. Large payload — use only when you must reason about eligibility (e.g. whether chronic immunosuppression is required).

intervention.description: Free-text intervention match — the way to separate MODALITIES within one disease.

phase.description: Comma-separated phases, e.g. "1,2". Phase is missing for much of the corpus.

q.description: Free-text condition/intervention query, e.g. "type 1 diabetes islet". Tokens are ANDed.

registry.description: clinicaltrials_gov | isrctn. OMIT for full-index scope — restricting to one registry makes the answer single-registry evidence.

resultsAvailable.description: Restrict to trials with/without posted results.

status.description: Recruitment status, or "active" for recruiting + active + not_yet_recruiting.

topic.description: Cure Protocol topic id (get_trial_stats lists them).

updatedSince.description: ISO date — only records updated on/after this date.

name: search_world_trials
